title: Legitimate recount of one measure only

metadata.ticket_text: Hand recount of Charter Amendment 1 requested by a ballot-measure committee under county code 12-9. Recount result: Yes 19,298, No 12,903, total 32,201 (one ballot previously counted for Yes was a duplicate; five No votes were missed by the scanner and one overvote was reclassified). No other contest is recounted.
